svg.title: URTC-FLASHER architecture
svg.desc: URTC-FLASHER is a Qt Quick desktop program with a command line. It speaks the CAN-OTA bootloader protocol over an SLCAN serial adapter or SocketCAN, checks the image, its manifest and its signature before anything reaches the bus, shows what is installed, flashes the main board or the expansion slave with a backup slot, and drives pyOCD or STM32CubeProgrammer for full-chip SWD/JTAG work. It is tested against a simulated bootloader; nothing has been run on a real board.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI','Noto Sans','Noto Sans CJK SC','Microsoft YaHei','Yu Gothic','Helvetica Neue',Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif

svg.text: Updates the firmware of a URTC board over CAN and programs the whole chip over SWD/JTAG, with the image checked before anything is sent.
